newsitem.title: FINLAND: TAMRO BUYS SWEDISH HOSPITAL EQUIPMENT CO.
newsitem.headline: TAMRO BUYS SWEDISH HOSPITAL EQUIPMENT CO.

text.p: Finnish pharmaceutical wholesaler Oy Tamro Ab said in a statement on Wednesday it was acquiring Swedish Hospital Supply SHS AB for an undisclosed sum from a private seller.
It said SHB markets hospital equipment and had 1995 net sales of about 40 million Swedish crowns which equals about 27 million markka.
"SHS AB's largest clients are the Swedish hospitals' purchasing organisation and healthcare equipment wholesalers. The bulk of the suppliers are foreign healthcare procuct makers," Tamro said.
The acquisition was an opening on the hospital equipment market in Sweden since Tamro's previous acquisitions were in laboratory products, it said.
